visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed banner teaser. A large full-width background image spans the section; a solid content box overlays the lower-left containing a heading, a descriptive paragraph, and a single CTA button. On narrow viewports the content box stacks at the bottom of the image.
contentPattern: Single-column rows: a background-image row plus a text row carrying title, description, and a CTA link.
usage: Prominent full-width promotional banner for a single featured trip/adventure, e.g. 'Next Adventures'.
